FROM (
  SELECT
    p.product_category_name,
    p.product_id,
    (p.product_length_cm * p.product_width_cm * p.product_height_cm) AS volume_cm3,
    p.product_photos_qty,
    SUM(i.price) AS total_revenue
  FROM order_items i
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
  WHERE i.shipping_limit_date >= '2018-01-01'
    AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2019-01-01'
    AND p.product_length_cm IS NOT NULL AND p.product_length_cm > 0
    AND p.product_width_cm IS NOT NULL AND p.product_width_cm > 0
    AND p.product_height_cm IS NOT NULL AND p.product_height_cm > 0
  GROUP BY p.product_category_name, p.product_id, p.product_length_cm, p.product_width_cm, p.product_height_cm, p.product_photos_qty
) t
JOIN (
  SELECT
    p.product_category_name,
    MAX(p.product_length_cm * p.product_width_cm * p.product_height_cm) AS max_volume_cm3
  FROM order_items i
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
  WHERE i.shipping_limit_date >= '2018-01-01'
    AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2019-01-01'
    AND p.product_length_cm IS NOT NULL AND p.product_length_cm > 0
    AND p.product_width_cm IS NOT NULL AND p.product_width_cm > 0
    AND p.product_height_cm IS NOT NULL AND p.product_height_cm > 0
  GROUP BY p.product_category_name
) m
  ON m.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
 AND m.max_volume_cm3 = t.volume_cm3
ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  i.seller_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) AS unique_products,
  AVG(p.product_photos_qty) AS avg_photos,
  AVG(i.price) AS avg_price,
  SUM(i.price) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name = 'esporte_lazer'
  AND i.shipping_limit_date >= '2017-10-01'
  AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY i.seller_id
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

쿼리 작성: SELECT

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  i.seller_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_category_name) AS category_count,
  AVG(p.product_weight_g) AS avg_weight_g
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE i.shipping_limit_date >= '2017-01-01'
  AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY i.seller_id;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  p.product_category_name,
  COUNT(*) AS item_count,
  AVG(i.price) AS avg_price
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE i.shipping_limit_date >= '2018-01-01'
  AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2018-04-01'
  AND p.product_length_cm >= 50
  AND p.product_length_cm <= 80
GROUP BY p.product_category_name;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  p.product_category_name,
  AVG(p.product_description_lenght / p.product_name_lenght) AS avg_desc_to_name_ratio,
  SUM(i.price) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE i.shipping_limit_date >= '2017-01-01'
  AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2019-01-01'
  AND p.product_name_lenght IS NOT NULL
  AND p.product_name_lenght > 0
  AND p.product_description_lenght IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_category_name;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  p.product_category_name,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_weight_g <= 2000 THEN i.price ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_weight_g IS NOT NULL THEN i.price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pct_revenue_le_2000g,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_weight_g > 2000 THEN i.price ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_weight_g IS NOT NULL THEN i.price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pct_revenue_gt_2000g
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE i.shipping_limit_date >= '2018-11-01'
  AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2018-12-01'
GROUP BY p.product_category_name;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  p.product_category_name,
  AVG(p.product_length_cm * p.product_width_cm * p.product_height_cm) AS avg_volume_cm3,
  AVG(i.freight_value) AS avg_freight
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE DATE(i.shipping_limit_date) = '2017-12-31'
  AND p.product_length_cm IS NOT NULL AND p.product_length_cm > 0
  AND p.product_width_cm IS NOT NULL AND p.product_width_cm > 0
  AND p.product_height_cm IS NOT NULL AND p.product_height_cm > 0
GROUP BY p.product_category_name;

쿼리 작성: WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    i.seller_id,
    i.product_id,
    p.product_category_name,
    i.price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.seller_id ORDER BY i.price DESC, i.order_id, i.order_item_id) AS rn
  FROM order_items i
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
  WHERE i.shipping_limit_date >= '2018-01-01'
    AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2019-01-01'
)
SELECT
  seller_id,
  product_id,
  product_category_name,
  price AS max_item_price
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  p.product_category_name,
  AVG(i.price) / AVG(p.product_photos_qty) AS avg_price_per_avg_photo,
  AVG(i.price) AS avg_price,
  AVG(p.product_photos_qty) AS avg_photos
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE i.shipping_limit_date >= '2017-07-01'
  AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2017-10-01'
  AND p.product_photos_qty IS NOT NULL
  AND p.product_photos_qty > 0
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY avg_price_per_avg_photo DESC
LIMIT 10;
